file_name: Australian Venue Co - assets of Molly's Irish Pub Highgate and Molly's Irish Pub Victoria Park, Perth, WA - third-party questionnaire_1.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any of AVC’s existing venues compete closely with either Molly’s Highgate or Molly’s Victoria Park and there are not many alternatives.
List which venues you consider to be alternatives to each of Molly’s Highgate and Molly’s Victoria Park.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Australian Venue Co and/or Molly’s Highgate or Molly’s Victoria Park.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
